name: fused_dual_residual_rmsnorm
description: fused_dual_residual_rmsnorm(x, residual, weight1, weight2, eps) -> (output, mid). x and residual have shape [B, H], and weight1 and weight2 have shape [H]. Compute in fp32 n1 = (x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)) * weight1, cast n1 to residual.dtype, and form mid = (residual + n1) cast to residual.dtype. Then compute output = ((mid / sqrt(mean(mid^2) + eps)) * weight2) cast to x.dtype. Returns newly allocated tensors output with x.dtype and mid with residual.dtype; residual itself is not mutated. For hidden > 8192 the implementation uses a multi-kernel fp32-intermediate path; otherwise it uses the fused single-pass kernel. The exercised dtype is bfloat16 with hidden sizes 16 to 8192.
